# netbox_event_rule (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox event rule (`/api/extras/event-rules/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_event_rule" "device_changes" {
  name = "device-changes"
}

output "device_changes_enabled" {
  value = data.netbox_event_rule.device_changes.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/event-rules/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `action_is_available` (Boolean) Action Is Available.
- `action_object_id` (Number) Action Object Id. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `action_object_type` (String) Action Object Type.
- `action_type` (String) Action Type. Valid values: `webhook`, `script`, `notification`.
- `conditions` (String) A set of conditions which determine whether the event will be generated.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The types of event which will trigger this rule. Valid values: `object_created`, `object_updated`, `object_deleted`, `job_started`, `job_completed`, `job_failed`, `job_errored`.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
